title: Book One · Chapter 13: The First Kite
story:
The kite is dry by Saturday morning.

Leo comes after breakfast. He looks at the paper first, then under it.

"It's still all there."

"Did you think I ate it?" Ronan asks.

"Then you need a very big bowl."

Dad takes them to an open yard behind the school. Miss Wu said yes to the families. They can use the yard this morning. There is no road through it. Two older children are playing with a soft ball at the far end.

Ronan carries the kite flat. Leo carries the string. Dad carries nothing except a bottle of water.

"Who's first?" Leo asks.

Ronan looks at the kite. He wants to be first. Leo said he could fly it. Ronan wants to see him do it.

"You."

Leo holds the string. Dad lifts the kite. A small wind moves the grass beside the wall.

"Ready?"

Leo runs. Dad lets go.

The kite jumps up, turns sharply, and falls on one corner.

Leo keeps running for three steps. The paper drags across the ground.

"Stop!" Ronan shouts.

Leo stops. Ronan runs to the kite. One edge has a new brown line, but it isn't torn.

"You pulled too hard."

"There wasn't enough wind."

"It went up."

"Then it came down."

Dad walks over. "Does it need another try?"

Ronan takes the string. He holds it the same way as Leo. This time Leo holds the kite. He pushes it up as Ronan starts.

The kite moves sideways. It turns over. Ronan sees both bamboo strips above his head for a moment. Then he sees the ground again.

The older children stop their ball.

"Nice fish," one calls.

Leo puts his hands on his hips. "It's a kite."

"Flying fish, then."

The older child runs after the ball. He doesn't wait for an answer.

Ronan feels angry. He looks at the older boy. Then he looks at Leo. He kicks a little dirt. The kite still lies on the ground.

Dad sits on the low wall. He offers them water.

"Which part failed?" he asks.

"All of it," Ronan says.

"Did the paper stay on?"

"Yes."

"Did the sticks break?"

"No."

"Then we can keep those parts."

Leo takes a drink. He looks at the string on the kite.

"My cousin has a kite. It has two little strings here. Ours has one."

"Why?" Ronan asks.

"I don't know."

Dad looks, too. He doesn't give a quick answer. "We can ask for help."

They try once more. Then they will go home. This time Ronan walks and Leo watches from the side. The kite points down almost at once.

Leo takes the pencil from Ronan's bag. On a spare piece of paper he draws a down arrow.

"Our kite goes down."

Ronan draws another arrow beside it. It points up.

"We want it to go up."

At home, they put the kite on the board again. Mum asks, "Did the kite fly?"

"Our kite falls very well," Ronan says.

Mum looks at his face before she laughs. Then he laughs, too, a little. Ronan puts the kite flat again. There are no big holes. They can use it for another try.

---

重点表达：pulled＝拉过、刚才拉了；falls＝落下；arrow＝箭头；try＝尝试。

理解问题：

1. 风筝第一次试飞时发生了什么？
2. 两人决定先记录哪个问题？
